top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a distinct invention, the many-atom magic-wavelength lattice clock that cancels the lattice light shift to first order, and its realisation at 10^-18 uncertainty, independently reproduced with Sr, Yb and Hg. It is separable from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes, and the two-name credit needs no forced exclusion. P002 is the broader discovery and a close second, but Cao, the parallel experimental groups and earlier twisted-bilayer theory sit outside three names and the Bistritzer seat is contested. P003 is secure science but has a contested third seat, the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang proposal and Hasan sit outside the names, and it follows the 2016 topology prize. All three are preferable to no award.
recusal_note: Documented ties to the Lund attosecond group (Anne L'Huillier), Ursula Keller's ETH group, Schuch, Dahlstrom, Argenti and Indelicato; none to Katori, Ye, MacDonald, Bistritzer, Jarillo-Herrero, Kane, Mele or Molenkamp. P001 is neighbouring AMO work, not my own subfield; no recusal apparent from profile.
